protocol.purpose: Learn from the complete 24 October review without fitting rules to those winners.
protocol.selection_rule: Lowest later-development validation race log loss, with no top-one or Brier deterioration versus the original architecture on identical fields, and lower raw-fold log loss in at least two of the three earlier chronological folds; otherwise retain original. All reported results are development evidence, not a new independent test.
protocol.comparison: Refit original architecture on the identical earlier training folds and original base feature definitions; never score an artifact on its own training races as validation.
protocol.test_policy: All model configurations must freeze before final_start. No Oct26+ outcomes can influence candidate selection, feature design or calibration. June4–September30 2026 remains retired and is not rescored in this run. October24 is reviewed development evidence and is not scored to select these models.
protocol.odds_policy: No SP, market rank, favourite flag or current price is a model input. Odds bands are retrospective diagnostics after frozen development predictions; early-price profitability requires separately timestamped quotes and terms.
protocol.data_policy: Earlier completed-day margins, comments, opposition and achieved ratings only. All same-day results excluded until the day ends. Archive versions are not independently timestamped, so archive gains cannot authorise production promotion.
protocol.promotion: RETAIN_ORIGINAL until a sufficiently sized, genuinely independent prospective comparison supports improvement.

limitations: Development periods were previously studied. They are not a new independent holdout.
Prior achieved ratings and current handicap marks lack certified historical version timestamps.
Starter fields are complete but historical declaration/non-runner timing is unavailable.
Odds diagnostics use result SP after prediction; no early-price betting profitability is inferred.
A long-priced winner is not automatically a predictable winner; comments are descriptive evidence.

protocol.reason: Cycle A improved overall development probability quality but worsened top-one winner detection above12/1; test nonlinear depth and learned ensemble weights without feeding prices into ability.
protocol.data: Same fixed31262-race development feature table,2019–2026-05-27; no October24 replay optimisation, retired test scoring or new final labels.
protocol.blend_learning: Nonnegative weights summing to one minimise earlier out-of-fold race winner log loss. Chronological fold1 uses equal weights; folds2/3 learn weights only from completed earlier folds. Later development validation uses weights learned from all three earlier folds.
protocol.gate: Lower later-development log loss, no top-one or Brier regression versus original_ensemble, lower log loss in at least2of3 genuine chronological folds, and at least the original's17 top-one and79 top-three detections among1063 winners above12/1 SP. These are development criteria, not independent evidence.
protocol.price_policy: No odds in fitted ability or blend weights. Starting-price bands are post-prediction development diagnostics; they are not verified early-price betting edges.
